Four lenses for supply chain decisions

Match the LUNA lens

For each business situation, decide which LUNA lens best helps you understand the supply chain challenge.

Every supply chain decision hides a different kind of challenge. LUNA gives you four lenses to spot which one you're dealing with, before you jump to a solution.

Linked Uncertain Non-linear Ambiguous

Debrief

Naming the challenge comes first

Why each lens fits

    Different challenges, different responses

    Before you can solve a supply chain problem well, you have to recognize what kind of problem it is.

    • LinkedLinked issues need cross-functional visibility.
    • UncertainUncertain ones need scenario thinking.
    • Non-linearNon-linear ones need attention to buffers and dependencies.
    • AmbiguousAmbiguous ones need explicit alignment on what "better" means.
